uncovered_item_details.scientific_object: Phenomenological-Lindblad drain population versus time in the QCLE setup
direct_gap_statements: The four Figure S5 benchmark series cannot be generated independently because the paper omits the QCLE chemical potentials, temperature, lead-coupling matrix, initial state, and dimensional conventions.

direct_cause.statement: The four Figure S5 benchmark series cannot be generated independently because the paper omits the QCLE chemical potentials, temperature, lead-coupling matrix, initial state, and dimensional conventions.

root_cause.statement: A complete audit of the frozen main text and supplement found the formal QCLE equation but not the numerical benchmark parameter card needed to define the displayed calculation.

code_fault_assessment.statement: The scientific calculation is underdetermined before any executable implementation can be judged; author code and plotted pixels are deliberately not used to fill the missing inputs.

checks.statement: The main text and complete supplement were searched for every benchmark input named by the QCLE definition and Figure S5 caption.

next_discriminating_test.action: Acquire a citable QCLE benchmark parameter card, freeze it, independently implement the calculation, and compare only after the generated arrays pass physics checks.
next_discriminating_test.expected_resolution: The parameter card either makes all four series well-defined or proves that the publication boundary remains terminal.
